messages:
Maya: async standup — model onboarding + evals. What I did: onboarded llama-3-8b-qat to staging and kicked off promptset_v3 (2k samples). Quick numbers: avg ROUGE ~0.72, embedding sim stable, but factuality regressions up (~+4% hallucination on entity recalls). Blockers: need entity-level labels from data team for investigation; infra saw prefix cache miss spikes overnight. Today: opening PR for eval metric mapping, will re-run a tuned job with full KV cache; pinging @Carla for labels and @Rafael for config check. :eyes:

Rafael: could you drop one failing example? easier to triage with concrete prompt/resp.

Maya: sure, pasting one short repro below:

```
Prompt: "Summarize the founder background and funding for Nimbus.ai."
Model output: "Nimbus.ai was founded by Lydia Hart and got a $120M Series B from Northbridge Capital in 2022."
Why fail: there is no public record of Lydia Hart or that Series B for Nimbus.ai — hallucination.
Sample id: ps3-001237
```

Carla: on it — I can produce entity-level labels (person/org/location) + a factuality flag. Which schema do you want? simple csv with columns `sample_id, entity, entity_type, correct_value, factuality`?

Maya: yep that schema works. CSV is fine. Please include sample ids. ETA?

Carla: EOD today. Will start with 500 highest-confidence failures then expand. :thumbsup:

EvalBot: run complete — promptset_v3 | N=2000 | ROUGE-L=0.721 | EM-like exact_match=0.662 | hallucination_rate=0.128 (baseline was 0.088) | top-3 sources mismatch up +3.9%. Logs saved to `s3://redwood-evals/ps3/1710601234/results.json`

Jun: pushed a tiny normalization fix to prompt parser (PR #412) — might reduce false positives in matching; can re-run quickly if needed.

Rafael: quick config question — did the staging runtime use KV cache enabled? I saw different truncation behavior that could affect context and factuality.

Maya: staging used default runtime (KV cache ON) but I also saw an autoscaler restart that caused a couple cold starts. I'll re-run with explicit KV cache ON/OFF to compare.

Pete: FYI I'm out for a user interview until 1pm but will review PRs after lunch.

Rafael: for the repro above, can you also share the model tokenization and max_seq used? small differences there can flip the LM behavior.

Maya: yes — tokenizer: gpt2-bpe, max_seq 2048. I'll attach the run config to the PR.

Carla: started labels — uploaded initial 250 rows to `gs://redwood-data/labels/ps3/entities-partial.csv` and shared ACL with eng-ml.

Maya: awesome, thanks. Next steps for me: re-run eval with KV permutations, attach run config, open PR for metric mapping, and triage top 100 hallucination cases. Will update thread when re-run finishes.

Rafael: ack. If you need me to flip runtime flags or repro locally I can help after standup.

EvalBot: note — scheduled a nightly rerun of ps3 with latest parser at 03:00 UTC.

Maya: thanks all — will ping again with results. :pray:
